meleeEvolution.name: Rusted Short Sword
meleeEvolution.notes: Starter sword from Commander Ekonta. Slash attacks with a forward-dash secondary. A safe early default while you look for upgrades.

meleeEvolution.name: Rusted Spear
materials: Reach Level 10 by fighting with this weapon
meleeEvolution.notes: Fast pierce spear found in the ruined tower near Knight's Encampment. Strong early reach choice; the secondary stab includes a backward dash.

meleeEvolution.name: Jigeki's Serpent Thrust
meleeEvolution.notes: Evolved form of the Rusted Spear. Builds a green eye meter while attacking; a full charge enables a poison strike that briefly stuns.

meleeEvolution.name: Holy Sword Endu
materials: Reach Level 10 by fighting with this weapon
meleeEvolution.notes: Recovered at Endu Shrine after the first boss. Slash kit with an air-dash secondary; Wind Gems add dashes, and the Storm Gem unlocks an ultimate.

meleeEvolution.name: Soul Bound Endu
meleeEvolution.notes: Evolved Endu form. Keeps the dash fantasy with stronger baseline power once the sword has been leveled through combat.

meleeEvolution.name: Wooden Club
meleeEvolution.notes: Slow impact club from a chest in the Isle of Neasied underground dungeon. Secondary is a leaping smash for committing to a hit.

meleeEvolution.name: Trident
meleeEvolution.notes: Pierce weapon mounted on a wall just outside the Obmuer Temple entrance. Useful pickup when you first arrive at that region.

meleeEvolution.name: Engraved Halberd
meleeEvolution.notes: Pierce/slash halberd in an Obmuer Temple chest behind the gate that needs three Trident Keys. Worth planning a trip once those keys are online.

meleeEvolution.name: Splash Hammer
meleeEvolution.notes: Heavy impact hammer from an Obmuer Temple chest. Charges an AOE smash on the secondary when its meter is full.

meleeEvolution.name: Azure Torch
meleeEvolution.notes: Utility weapon from a gargoyle at the Tower of Knowledge entrance. Lights the way, fuels Azure Flame fireballs, and can light gargoyle statues for the tower door puzzle.

throwing.name: Throwing Dagger
throwing.rechargeNote: Recharges over time while equipped; shop sells extra charges after you unlock it
throwing.notes: Starter throwable from the Dagger Belt early on Neasied. Fast return, light physical hits. Later can gain an Acid upgrade after the Necronomicon for clearing flesh in the Tower of Knowledge.

throwing.name: Throwing Axe
throwing.rechargeNote: Recharges over time while equipped; slower return than daggers
throwing.notes: Heavier slash/impact throw found in a Deimpo Mausoleum chest. Better when you want chunkier single hits than dagger spam.

throwing.name: Chakram
throwing.notes: Boomerang-style slash throw from a chest outside Obmuer Temple. Returns after traveling a set distance — good for clipping packs on a path.

throwing.name: Piercing Needle
throwing.notes: Pierce throwable that passes through multiple targets. Chest right after the Sacred Cistern in Obmuer Temple.

throwing.name: Occult Knife
throwing.notes: Homing physical knife from a Tower of Knowledge chest. Strong when you need the throw to finish tracking a moving target.
